SHARED-F-1-S182.title: Core Allowlist Enforcement Logic
SHARED-F-1-S182.description: Implement strict allowlist enforcement within the tool router to ensure only explicitly registered tools can be executed, rejecting any unknown or malformed tool calls before reaching domain services.

SHARED-F-1-S183.title: Pydantic Validation Execution and Error Handling
SHARED-F-1-S183.description: Execute Pydantic model validation for all tool inputs and implement standardized error handling for validation failures, including safe user-facing responses and internal error propagation.

SHARED-F-1-S184.title: Tool Router Security Logging and Audit Trail
SHARED-F-1-S184.description: Add structured logging for all tool routing decisions, including allowed, rejected, and validation-failed tool calls, integrating with existing debug logging infrastructure for auditability.

SHARED-F-1-S185.title: Dynamic Tool Registration and Mapping
SHARED-F-1-S185.description: Implement a centralized mechanism to register and map tools to their corresponding Pydantic models and execution handlers, ensuring consistency between allowlist definitions and runtime behavior.

SHARED-F-1-S186.title: Graceful Handling of Unsupported Tool Calls
SHARED-F-1-S186.description: Implement fallback behavior for unsupported or disallowed tool calls, returning controlled responses to the LLM loop without breaking conversation flow or exposing internal errors.
